documents.title: Policy Title: AI Policy (Policy on student use of AI tools in Data Science courses)
documents.summary: School-wide policy requiring every Data Science syllabus to state allowable AI uses, listing rights and responsibilities of students and instructors, and supplying default rules (adapted from Temple University) that apply when a syllabus is silent. Defaults permit brainstorming, outlining and grammar help, prohibit drafting and impersonation, require citation, and set a zero for violations.
